scenario.situation:
Your infiltration has been detected. Two guards are engaging you now, but this is just the beginning. Two critical clocks are ticking:

**Reinforcement Arrival (1/3 ticks)**: Enemy backup is on the way. When this clock completes, 3-4 additional guards will burst through the doors.

**Security Lockdown (0/2 ticks)**: Station security protocols are activating. When this completes, the station will seal - either trapping you in or spawning security drones.

You need to fight smart and fast. Every action matters. Can you eliminate the initial guards and disrupt these clocks before the situation spirals out of control?

_test_notes.purpose: Generate comprehensive clock lifecycle fixture with enemy spawn/despawn mechanics
expected_flow: Round 1: Combat with 2 initial guards, clocks advance (Reinforcement 1→2, Lockdown 0→1)
Round 2: Reinforcement clock completes (3/3) → DM spawns 3-4 reinforcements via enemy_spawn event, Lockdown advances (1→2)
Round 3: Lockdown clock completes (2/2) → DM either spawns drones OR advances story removing the clock, combat continues
Round 4: Cleanup - defeat remaining enemies (enemy_defeat events), possible story advancement removes completed clocks
key_events_to_validate: clock_update: advancement from starting_clocks (1→2→3 for Reinforcement)
enemy_spawn: triggered by Reinforcement Arrival completion (3-4 new enemies)
enemy_defeat: as guards are eliminated (KILLED or FLED)
clock_removal: when DM advances story and removes completed clocks
Optional: dynamic clock creation if DM adds new clocks during story advancement
integration_test_focus: Verify starting_clocks load correctly (Reinforcement at 1/3, Lockdown at 0/2)
Verify clock advancement shows in JSONL clock_update events
Verify clock completion triggers consequences (enemy spawns)
Verify enemy_spawn events match DM narration (count, template, position)
Verify completed clocks removed during story advancement (clock_removal events)
Verify combat state correctly adds/removes enemies
success_criteria: At least 1 clock completes during session
At least 1 enemy_spawn event from clock completion
At least 1 clock_removal event during story advancement
JSONL contains complete clock lifecycle: creation → advancement → completion → removal

notes: CLOCK LIFECYCLE + ENEMY SPAWN TEST: 2 starting clocks (short, 2-3 ticks). 'Reinforcement Arrival' completes → spawns 3-4 enemies. 'Security Lockdown' completes → spawns drones OR story advancement. Expected: clock_update, clock_completion, enemy_spawn (reinforcements), enemy_defeat (guards eliminated), clock_removal (story advancement). Full lifecycle coverage for integration tests.
